acceptable_references.label: Section 126
acceptable_references.reason: defines wrongful restraint, the lesser included offence

required_points: Section 127 defines wrongful confinement as wrongfully restraining any person in such a manner as to prevent that person from proceeding beyond certain circumscribing limits.
For example, causing Z to go within a walled space and locking Z in constitutes wrongful confinement.
optional_points: Wrongful confinement is an aggravated form of wrongful restraint; it prevents movement in all directions beyond a circumscribing limit.
forbidden_points: Wrongful confinement requires use of physical force.
Wrongful confinement is the same as wrongful restraint.
